entries.title: Proverbs 11:1
segments: ¶Dishonest scales [are] an abomination to the LORD, But a just weight [is] His delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:2
segments: ¶When pride comes, then comes shame; But with the humble [is] wisdom.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:3
segments: ¶The integrity of the upright will guide them, But the perversity of the unfaithful will destroy them.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:4
segments: ¶Riches do not profit in the day of wrath, But righteousness delivers from death.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:5
segments: ¶The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way aright, But the wicked will fall by his own wickedness.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:6
segments: The righteousness of the upright will deliver them, But the unfaithful will be caught by [their] lust.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:7
segments: ¶When a wicked man dies, [his] expectation will perish, And the hope of the unjust perishes.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:8
segments: ¶The righteous is delivered from trouble, And it comes to the wicked instead.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:9
segments: ¶The hypocrite with [his] mouth destroys his neighbor, But through knowledge the righteous will be delivered.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:10
segments: ¶When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices; And when the wicked perish, [there is] jubilation.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:11
segments: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted, But it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:12
segments: ¶He who is devoid of wisdom despises his neighbor, But a man of understanding holds his peace.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:13
segments: A talebearer reveals secrets, But he who is of a faithful spirit conceals a matter.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:14
segments: ¶Where [there is] no counsel, the people fall; But in the multitude of counselors [there is] safety.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:15
segments: ¶He who is surety for a stranger will suffer, But one who hates being surety is secure.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:16
segments: ¶A gracious woman retains honor, But ruthless [men] retain riches.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:17
segments: ¶The merciful man does good for his own soul, But [he who is] cruel troubles his own flesh.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:18
segments: ¶The wicked [man] does deceptive work, But he who sows righteousness [will have] a sure reward.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:19
segments: ¶As righteousness [leads] to life, So he who pursues evil [pursues it] to his own death.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:20
segments: ¶Those who are of a perverse heart [are] an abomination to the LORD, But [the] blameless in their ways [are] His delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:21
segments: ¶[Though they join] forces, the wicked will not go unpunished; But the posterity of the righteous will be delivered.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:22
segments: ¶[As] a ring of gold in a swine's snout, [So is] a lovely woman who lacks discretion.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:23
segments: ¶The desire of the righteous [is] only good, [But] the expectation of the wicked [is] wrath.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:24
segments: ¶There is [one] who scatters, yet increases more; And there is [one] who withholds more than is right, But it [leads] to poverty.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:25
segments: ¶The generous soul will be made rich, And he who waters will also be watered himself.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:26
segments: ¶The people will curse him who withholds grain, But blessing [will be] on the head of him who sells [it].

entries.title: Proverbs 11:27
segments: ¶He who earnestly seeks good finds favor, But trouble will come to him who seeks [evil].

entries.title: Proverbs 11:28
segments: ¶He who trusts in his riches will fall, But the righteous will flourish like foliage.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:29
segments: ¶He who troubles his own house will inherit the wind, And the fool [will be] servant to the wise of heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:30
segments: ¶The fruit of the righteous [is a] tree of life, And he who wins souls [is] wise.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:31
segments: ¶If the righteous will be recompensed on the earth, How much more the ungodly and the sinner.
